name: What factors should I consider when choosing a listing agent after my FSBO experience?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a listing agent after my FSBO experience?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a listing agent after an FSBO attempt, consider their experience, local market knowledge, and marketing strategy. Look for an agent with a proven track record of successful sales in your specific area, whether it's Aventura or Coral Gables, as their understanding of local market nuances is crucial. Review their proposed marketing plan, including online presence, professional photography, and open house strategies. It's also important to assess their communication style and responsiveness, as effective communication is key to a smooth selling process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider an agent's experience, local market knowledge in your area, marketing strategy, and communication style when making your selection.
